body_markdown:
**Sydney, Australia, 23 November 2026** | The Magnum Ice Cream Company has restarted production of the iconic Magnum Ego at its Minto facility in New South Wales this month.


The 2026 relaunch reaffirms The Magnum Ice Cream Company’s broader commitment to Australian manufacturing and consumer preferences, with an AU$6million investment in the site securing the development of the specialised manufacturing capabilities, production processes and technical expertise required to produce the complex, multi-layered Magnum Ego exclusively for the Australian market. The investment follows the


[previously announced AU$35 million transformation of its Minto facility, home of the Streets ice cream range.](https://news.magnumicecream.com/minto-factory-transformation-australia/)


Invented in Australia in 1998, Magnum Ego quickly built a loyal following for its distinctive layered format. After it was discontinued in 2025, Australians kept asking for it back. Local teams have spent almost two years making sure its return is worth the wait, recapturing the premium quality that made the original so loved.


**Scott Mingl, General Manager, The Magnum Ice Cream Company Australia and New Zealand** , said,


*“Magnum Ego is one of Australia’s great ice cream inventions, and it holds a special place for many of us who grew up with it. The layers that make it so distinctive also make it one of the most complex ice creams we produce, and we wanted to do the original justice. That’s why we’ve invested in our Minto factory, and why we spent almost two years refining it.*


*“Seeing it back in freezers is a proud moment for our whole team. We can’t wait for Australians to taste it again, and for a whole new generation to discover it this summer.”*


**Member for Macquarie Fields, Anoulack Chanthivong MP,** said the relaunch of Magnum Ego demonstrated that it was an exciting time for domestic manufacturing. ****


*“The relaunch of this popular product is made possible due to the significant investment in manufacturing and innovation capability at The Magnum Ice Cream Company’s Minto facility.*


*“It’s wonderful to see Magnum’s commitment to NSW manufacturing and innovation, boosting local jobs and re-creating an iconic product from Minto to the world.”*


Ahead of the icon’s return to Australian shores, local Research, Development & Innovation (RD&I) and manufacturing teams went back to the original 1998 paper recipes and paired them with modern product development expertise. Working closely with suppliers, the team tested 29 versions of the caramel recipe and conducted multiple production trials to recreate the quality Australians remembered.


The team also used AI-assisted analysis tools to support their work, assess ingredient differences and identify potential technical solutions before physical trials began. Every product decision was made by the team and validated through hands-on development, manufacturing trials and commercial-scale testing.


**Luke Cartwright, RD&I Lead at The Magnum Ice Cream Company** , said


*“Bringing Magnum Ego back was about more than relaunching a product. We were determined to recapture the quality so many Australians remember, which is why we started with the paper recipes.*


*The caramel was our biggest technical challenge. It had to deliver the right taste and texture at freezer temperature, while also performing reliably on the production line. Every one of our 29 iterations brought us closer to the Magnum Ego ice cream Australians have been waiting for.*


*“It’s a product with a lot of moving parts, and every layer has to come together consistently, every time. Getting that right is a real demonstration of our team’s technical expertise and attention to detail.”*


The finished product combines velvety vanilla ice cream, a thin choc layer and a gooey caramel centre, encased in Magnum signature cracking milk chocolate shell. Both the caramel and cream are sourced from Australian suppliers. At 100ml, the new Magnum Ego is also larger than the 85ml version last available in Australia.


Since first launching in 1989, Magnum has built a global reputation as one of the world’s leading premium indulgence ice cream brands. In Australia, Magnum is the #1 indulgence brand in Portioned Multipacks in Grocery1 and the #1 impulse brand in Total Convenience2.


Magnum Ego is now available at petrol and convenience stores nationwide.
